items.summary: An Amazon drone "struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff," a preliminary FAA report stated.

Emerging Market Stocks Rally as Huang’s Return Revives AI Trade
items.summary: Emerging-market stocks rallied the most since July as investors snapped up artificial intelligence shares after Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp.

items.title: Lookonchain Flags Suspected Hack of Ansem-Linked Wallet
items.summary: The tracker reported 2.15 million USDC moved to Arbitrum. Records link 1.55 million USDC directly to the Ansem-associated wallet through Relay.

items.title: Lithuanian SIM cards found in Russian drones that attacked Ukraine
items.summary: Lithuanian prepaid SIM cards have been found in Russian drones that attacked Ukraine in 2025, the Lithuanian outlet 15 min reported, citing data from Ukrainian military intelligence. The 15 min article is behind a paywall; it was summarized by Delfi and LRT.
